note: Every sentence and number in nutrients.json cites one or more ids from this list. Every page was read on 2026-10-01 (text saved by tools/nutrients_fetch.py into the git-ignored .refs/nutrients/). The NIH Office of Dietary Supplements fact sheets and Health Canada DRI tables were the first choice but could not be read from this machine (ODS returned a Cloudflare browser check, NCBI Bookshelf a reCAPTCHA, canada.ca timed out), so the same National Academies DRI tables were read at nap.nationalacademies.org and nutrient detail at the Linus Pauling Institute Micronutrient Information Center. Manganese, molybdenum and chromium were added the same day; the ODS fact sheets for all three (and the ODS API) again returned HTTP 403, so they rest on the LPI pages and the same NAP tables.

sources.title: Linus Pauling Institute Micronutrient Information Center: Molybdenum
sources.licence: Copyright 2001-2026 Linus Pauling Institute; site terms forbid copying, allow hyperlinks (facts paraphrased here, not copied)
sources.checked: Essential for virtually all life; molybdenum cofactor (Moco); four enzymes; sulfite oxidase crucial; xanthine and aldehyde oxidase; dietary deficiency never observed, one TPN case; Moco deficiency and sulfite oxidase loss; thiomolybdate and copper in ruminants; low toxicity, 10 to 15 mg/day gout-like symptoms; food sources and soil. Page updated May 2021, reviewed June 2021.

sources.title: Linus Pauling Institute Micronutrient Information Center: Chromium
sources.licence: Copyright 2001-2026 Linus Pauling Institute; site terms forbid copying, allow hyperlinks (facts paraphrased here, not copied)
sources.checked: Discovered 1797; Cr3+ main form; essentiality questioned, IOM AI 2001, EFSA 2014 no requirement; proposed insulin role and chromodulin model not confirmed in vivo; effects only at pharmacological doses; dietary deficiency not observed, TPN cases hard to interpret; no UL, caution advised; chromium picolinate kidney reports; hexavalent chromium carcinogen when inhaled; food sources and batch variation. Page updated November 2022, reviewed January 2024.
